en.headline: M+ opens Herzog & de Meuron architecture display on Saturday
en.dek: Models, drawings and material samples from the Swiss firm that designed M+ and Tai Kwun go on view in the Focus Gallery from 12 September to 10 January.
body: M+ will open Herzog & de Meuron: In Focus in its second-floor Focus Gallery on Saturday, 12 September, running until 10 January 2027. The museum said the display marks a second donation to the M+ Collections by the Swiss architecture firm that designed the M+ building, and forms part of events around the museum's fifth anniversary.

The exhibition gathers newly donated models, drawings and material samples from built and unbuilt projects in China between 2002 and 2021, including M+ (2012–2021), Tai Kwun in Central (2006–2018) and Beijing's National Stadium (2002–2008), together with urban-planning studies. Objects are shown in replica wooden vitrines modelled on the Kabinett archive the firm maintains in Basel.

The display is curated by Ikko Yokoyama, M+'s senior curator and head of design and architecture, with assistant curator Iris Ng. M+ said guided architecture tours by volunteer guides will run during the exhibition period.
The Focus Gallery follows the museum's usual opening hours in the West Kowloon Cultural District. Admission is by standard M+ ticket. The museum is closed on Mondays.

zh.headline: M+周六起展出Herzog & de Meuron建築捐贈
zh.dek: 設計M+及大館的瑞士事務所向博物館第二期捐贈的模型、繪圖及物料樣本，9月12日至明年1月10日於二樓焦點空間展出。
body: M+將於周六（9月12日）在二樓焦點空間揭幕「Herzog & de Meuron：聚焦」，展期至2027年1月10日。博物館表示，展覽配合M+開幕五周年，展出該瑞士建築事務所向M+館藏第二期捐贈的作品。M+大樓正是由同一事務所設計。
展品包括2002至2021年間該所在中國已建成及未建成項目的模型、繪圖及物料樣本，當中有M+（2012–2021）、中環大館（2006–2018）及北京國家體育場（2002–2008），以及都市規劃研究。展品置於仿照事務所巴塞爾Kabinett檔案庫的木製展示櫃內。
展覽由M+設計及建築首席策展人橫山郁子策劃，助理策展人吳穎琳協助。博物館表示展期內將由義工導賞員帶領建築導賞。
焦點空間跟隨西九M+一般開放時間，周一休館，入場按M+常規門票安排。
